name: Marryk Nurribit
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Marryk Nurribit teaches young gnomes the arcane arts. He favors local brews over strict lessons and often asks his pupils for spare coins to buy a drink.

sections.title: Arcane Studies and Ale
sections.body: Marryk Nurribit teaches young gnomes magic inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He knows the arcane arts, though he takes a casual approach to teaching. A flagon of dwarven ale often holds more of his attention than a lesson, and he asks his new pupils for spare pocket change. He also warns aspiring spellcasters about the dangers beyond Coldridge Valley, where Gnomeregan's ruins remain radioactive and infested with troggs.

faq.answer: Marryk Nurribit trains gnomes in arcane magic inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh. He teaches newly arrived gnome mages the fundamentals of the art.

faq.q: Why does Marryk keep asking for money for beer?
aliases: why does he ask for coins
faq.answer: Marryk enjoys local spirits and often asks his students for spare change to pay for beer at the tavern.

faq.q: What does Marryk say about Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Marryk warns new mages not to underestimate the dangers in Gnomeregan's irradiated ruins.

angles.text: As a gnome mage starting out in Coldridge Valley, you turn to Marryk for your first spells and your Glyphic Memorandum.
As a gnome taking shelter in Dun Morogh, you know Marryk as a scholar who has taken readily to dwarven tavern life.
